name: fire_tick_delay_seeded
description: Fire on netherrack (infiniburn), lit by a script setBlock with flags 3 at tick 0. FireBlock.onPlace and every FireBlock.tick reschedule the fire at fireTickDelay + level.random.nextInt(10); with no player near, canSpreadFireAround is false and the tick draws nothing else. The scheduled delays come from the seeded level RNG (seed site 1): Paper twin admission holds only if that seed takes effect.
